| Category | Property | Value / Description |

| **Basic Atomic Data** | Symbol | H |
| | Atomic number | 1 |
| | Atomic mass (average) | 1.008 u |
| | Electron configuration | 1s¹ |
| | Isotopes | Protium (¹H, 99.98 %), Deuterium (²H, 0.02 %) – stable; Tritium (³H) – radioactive, t½ ≈ 12.32 yr |

| | First ionization energy | 13.598 eV |
| | Electron affinity | –0.754 eV (negative, meaning it releases energy when gaining an electron) |

| | Color | Colorless |
| | Odor | Odorless |
| | Taste | Tasteless |
| | Density | 0.08988 g L⁻¹ (≈ 0.0000899 g cm⁻³) |
